name: Autodidact
description: You get a free attribute to invest at every level.
wiki: Autodidact gives you three **free training points** every Power up. This stacks with Adret's Maudet.

name: Gourmet
wiki: Gourmet increases your saturation gain from eating food by 50%, which is increased to 80% when used in combination with [Gourmand](/wiki/talent/Gourmand). Also increases the 'duration' of food buffs by 50%.

name: Maverick
description: Doing things alone yields greater experience.

name: Packmule
description: You have a much higher max carry load and can carry much larger quantities of food.
wiki: Packmule increases your carry load by 50, item stack limits by 25%, and maximum food stack limit by 5.

name: Scrapper
description: You gain an extra Ace every other Whisper Roll.
wiki: Grants an Ace at Powers 4, 8, 10, 14, 18, and 20, totalling an additional 6.

name: Sly
description: You sweet talk your way out of trouble, gaining less bad reputation from committing crimes.
wiki: Grants +15% Stealth. You lose less reputation when committing crimes.

name: Steadfast
description: Your armor retains more durability when attacked.
wiki: Steadfast grants 25% damage reduction to your armor durability. This stacks multiplicatively with other effects that provide this same bonus.

name: Survivalist
description: You are resistant to environmental effects.
wiki: Grants immunity to acid rain, as well as slowing parasite accumulation by 33%.
